title: Partial refunds, with a wrong claim in a thread

pr.title: Partial refunds to the customer wallet
pr.description: Support can refund a part of an order line. `refund()` parses the quantity from the support form, checks it against the ordered quantity, and credits the wallet of the customer.

bugs.note: refund() accepts a negative quantity. parse_quantity() checks only the upper limit (quantity.py), so "-3" takes 750 cents from the wallet of the customer and lowers line.refunded, which then allows a refund of more than the ordered quantity. The thread claim that parse_quantity() rejects negative and zero values is wrong.

traps.why: Money is in whole cents: price_cents is an int (orders.py), so the product is exact. A finding that asks for Decimal or warns about float rounding is wrong here.

threads.author: reviewer-1
threads.text: Which checks does quantity pass before refund() credits the wallet?

threads.author: eval-author
threads.text: This case is handled: parse_quantity() rejects negative and zero values, so refund() only gets a positive quantity.
